'''Mills''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] who once escaped [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] to escape [[Logron]]'s thugs.<ref name="EOTE CR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mills was first mentioned in the example of play for the introductory adventure in [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]].
